items.title: Nat Hentoff interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: who learned at the hands of Sunnyland Slim and Memphis Slim and all those people

ctx.x: That’s it, yeah. I just did a piece for the Wall Street Journal on a 46-year-old guy named Barrelhouse Chuck Goering, who is half Cherokee, who learned at the hands of Sunnyland Slim and Memphis Slim and all those people, and he sounds now, I mean he keeps the blues alive. And he was telling me that he went to an elementary school and was playing the piano and singing and telling stories about Otis Spann and not only Otis Spann but Muddy Waters, who was one of his mentors. And a 9-year-old girl said, “how come we…
That they sort of have a monopoly on what is —
